plates.name: 19_branches
plates.formula: Initial 7; middle m from -5 to 5; fine preimage n=m/2 only for even m.

plates.name: 23_cycle_primitive
plates.formula: Repaired differences (3/4,-1/4,-1/4,-1/4); anchor primitive (0,3/4,1/2,1/4); mean shift -3/8.

plates.name: 24_reflection_cycle
plates.formula: Triangle with identity tree edges and reflection J=diag(1,-1) on the closing edge; fixed anchors (a,0).

plates.name: 25_summable_path
plates.model: f_n=(s,1/(n+1)); maximum-norm movement=1/((n+1)(n+2)); exact distance to limit=1/(n+1).

plates.name: 26_residual_bursts
plates.model: q_even=2; q_odd=1/8; Q_even=4^-k; Q_odd=2*4^-k; finite plotted n=0..16.

plates.name: 27_path_limits
plates.model: Paths (s,a*(1-2^-n),2^-n), a=-1,0,1, n=0..6; open endpoint markers are exact limits at r=0.

plates.name: 28_escaping_repair
plates.model: Squared correction=N; infinite residual square between 1/(N+1) and 1/N. Band is certified inequality, not an evaluated infinite tail.

plates.name: 29_transport_cost
plates.model: Free path category with A->B=0, B->A=0, A->C=2, C->A=5, D isolated. Diagram shows generators; shortest path costs are calculated separately.

plates.name: 30_phase
plates.model: G=F2^2 ordered [0,e1,e2,e1+e2]; c(x,y)=x2*y1 modulo 2; all 16 table values explicit.

report.scope: Vector plots of explicit formulas. One axes per figure. No new formal theorem or AI-generated illustration.

plates.name: 31_nested_energy
plates.formula: N versus sum(n^-2,n<=N), bound 2. Both use T diagonal(1/n), with different fixed data.

plates.name: 32_budget_certificate
plates.formula: T=diag(1,1/2), r=(1,1), a=(1/2,2/5), ||a||=sqrt(41)/10. Image ellipse axes M,M/2. Tangent normal v=(1/2,4/5).

plates.name: 33_budget_uncertainty
plates.formula: Scalar nominal T=1,r=1; delta=1/20,eta=1/10; profiles bracketed by beta +/- (delta+eta*M), lower clipped at zero.

plates.name: 34_noise_filter
plates.formula: Three scalar noise response functions sigma/(sigma^2+alpha); alpha=1/16,1/4,1. Points at sharp maximum sigma=sqrt(alpha).

plates.name: 35_regularized_escape
plates.formula: Exact coordinate values m^2/(m^2+n^2), m=4,16,64. Marked threshold n=m has coordinate 1/2.

plates.name: 36_budget_product
plates.formula: Exact rational partial sums with K=32m, the diagonal tail bounds; product enclosures sqrt(Alo*Blo),sqrt(Ahi*Bhi). Hard prefix intervals [sqrt(m/(m+1)),1]. Finite series arithmetic is exact before plotting roundoff.

report.scope: Plots of explicit formulas and exact rational finite sums with written infinite-tail bounds. Plot coordinates are rounded for display. No new Lean proof.

plates.name: 37_solver_amplification
plates.formula: Universal bounds eps/alpha and eps/(2 sqrt(alpha)), eps=10^-5. Not observed errors.

plates.name: 39_covector_metric
plates.formula: Same proposal=(1/4,1/4); B_s=s(1,1), G_s=2s^2, q_s=-s/4. Raw norm changes; Gram-corrected norm is constant.

plates.name: 40_stopping_schedule
plates.formula: Attainable diagonal model: m=ceil(delta^-2/3), alpha=m^-2, kappa=1/4. All curves are bounds, not empirical errors.

report.scope: Floating-point rendering of explicit formulas whose mathematical proofs and exact finite checks are supplied separately.
